chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Hajjal, from Suleiman al-Ja'fari, who said:

I was sick to the extent that my flesh wasted away, so I visited Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him). He said: 'Would you be pleased if your flesh were to return to you?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Frequent the bathhouse intermittently, for it will cause your flesh to return. And beware of making it a habit, for habitual bathing causes tuberculosis (consumption).'
ai.seo_question: What is the medical advice of Imam al-Rida regarding bathing and weight loss?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the practical medical wisdom of Imam al-Rida (AS), who prescribed intermittent bathing to restore physical vitality while cautioning against the excesses that lead to *al-Sill* (consumption or wasting disease). It reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating spiritual guidance with empirical health practices, emphasizing moderation (*wasatiyyah*) in bodily care as a means to preserve the trust of the body.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Hajjal, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary who said,

‘I was sick to the extent that my flesh went away. So I went over to Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Would you be joyful if I<sup>asws</sup> were to return your flesh to you?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Necessitate the bathing intermittently so it would return back to you your flesh, and beware of being habitual of it, for being habitual in it inherits the tuberculosis’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad al-Hajj al from Sulayman al- Ja’fariy who has said the following:

“Once I became ill until I lost all of my flesh. I visited al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who asked, ‘Will you like to see your flesh come back?’ I replied, ‘Yes, I like to see my flesh come back.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘You must continue taking a bath one day and on the day after the next day, your flesh will come back. You must not take a bath every day because it causes tuberculosis.’” (Perhaps if it is a public bathhouse)
